name: Trawler’s Empire
detailed_description:
🎣 Trawler’s Empire – Master the Seas, Build Your Legacy

Trawler’s Empire is a relaxing yet rewarding idle fishing tycoon game where you cast your line, build your fleet, and dominate the seas. Start from humble beginnings at a local pond and expand your fishing empire across vast waters filled with rare and valuable fish species.

🌊 Gameplay Features:

⚓ Explore Multiple Fishing Locations:
From peaceful ponds to deep oceans teeming with exotic fish, unlock new locations with every upgrade.

🐟 Fish Encyclopedia:
Discover and collect over a dozen unique fish species, each with their own rarity, stats, and value.

🚢 Upgrade Your Fleet:
Customize and upgrade your boat for better fishing power and efficiency. Invest wisely to increase your catch rate and earnings.

💰 Idle & Auto-Fishing System:
Your trawler keeps working while you’re away! Earn offline income, catch fish, and stack profits even when idle.

📈 Prestige System:
Reset your progress for permanent upgrades. Earn fishing power bonuses, increase fish values, and start stronger each time you prestige.

🏆 Become the Ultimate Fishing Tycoon:
Optimize your empire, master the seas, and build your legacy as the wealthiest fisherman.

✨ Key Highlights:

  • Incremental gameplay with satisfying progression

  • Fun upgrades and unlockable locations

  • Prestiging for permanent bonuses

  • A relaxing atmosphere perfect for idle tycoon fans

Are you ready to cast your line and build your Trawler's Empire?
Set sail today and watch your fishing fortune grow!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 8 / Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core CPU (Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R3 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / GTX 750 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Linux
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.6 GHz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0+ or Vulkan-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Linux (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2 (Steam Deck APU or equivalent)
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
